name: token-sieve
description: Keep verbose command output out of model context while preserving full local logs and original exit status.

interface.shortDescription: Compact tool output with recoverable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Capture verbose builds, tests and searches locally; return bounded excerpts and inspect exact line ranges on demand.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Token Sieve to reduce verbose tool output while retaining the full logs and checking actual exit status.
